summary: Completed Module 2 BUILD Chunk 1 by implementing parallel lint/test CI workflow logic and validating fail-fast behavior using local CI command parity.
evidence: Created workflow file `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with push trigger on `main` and two independent parallel jobs: `lint` and `test`.

Remote CI execution was unavailable because this workspace had no git metadata/remote (`fatal: not a git repository`), so fail-fast behavior was verified locally using the same CI commands configured in the workflow.

Intentional controlled failure: changed assertion in `api/app/scripts/test_query_columns.py` from `WHERE short_code = :code` to `WHERE code = :code`, then ran `python app/scripts/test_query_columns.py` and captured `AssertionError`.
Verified downstream stage did not execute: ran `set -e; python app/scripts/test_query_columns.py; echo "DOWNSTREAM_BUILD_STAGE_RAN"` and confirmed sentinel output never printed after test failure.

Reverted intentional failure in `api/app/scripts/test_query_columns.py` and re-verified green baseline: `ruff check app --select E9,F63,F7,F82` returned `All checks passed!`, and `python app/scripts/test_query_columns.py` returned `PASS: query uses short_code.`
